children: AH Realty Trust announced a strategic transformation including a $485M multifamily sale, reduced leverage to 7.1x and an 8.6% dividend yield backed by AFFO coverage.
Closed sale of nine multifamily assets for $485M; total multifamily proceeds expected ~ $562M including remaining PSAs.
Net debt/adjusted EBITDAre improved to 7.1x in 2Q26 (from ~8.3x in 1Q26); target post-transformation 5.5x–6.5x.
Dividend yield of 8.6% described as AFFO-covered and cash flow positive after dividend reset to sustainable level.
2Q26 operational metrics: retail same-store NOI +2.9% cash, office same-store NOI +8.3% cash; retail renewal spread +8.7% cash.
Returned capital: repurchased ~5.6M shares for $33.2M YTD and increased repurchase authorization to $100M.
